title: Experimental evidence of an upper limit for hydrogen storage at 77 K on activated carbons
material_description: M1149 | activated carbon from Moszczenica (Polish) anthracite, activated at Wroclaw University of Technology; chemical activation with alkali hydroxide (NaOH or KOH, conditions of this sample not stated); grains 100-200 um
purification_method: washed with 1 M HCl, then distilled water until rinse pH constant near 6; dried in oven 24 h; sieved to 100-200 um
activation_method: anthracite ground (100-200 um) and physically mixed with alkali hydroxide XOH (X = Na or K), mass ratio XOH/anthracite 1 to 3, heated in N2 flow to Ta 973-1073 K for 1 h; route of this sample not stated
source_location: Table 2, row M1149, column "At 298 K and 5 MPa (%), IJL volumetric device" (p. 1908)
notes: Printed +/- 0.1. Pressure 5 MPa = 50 bar. Excess is named in the Table 2 title ("Hydrogen uptake (excess)") but not defined in the text, so basis_stated is false. wt% is "of the outgassed activated carbons" (Table 2 title), coded W1 stated. IJL laboratory-made volumetric device; outgassed 48 h under secondary vacuum (temperature not stated); H2 purity ">5 N" stored as 99.999; no free-volume determination stated (Hemmes equation of state, correction for compression outside the vessel and water-column check only), so calibration_described is false. Table 1: rho_He 1.61 +/- 0.28 g/cm3 (skeletal density); S_BET from N2 at 77 K, BET P/P0 range and consistency criteria not stated; V_DR,N2 DR fit range Log(P0/P)^2 4.3-11.2, V_DR,CO2 (CO2 at 273 K) range 4.2-9.9; N2/CO2 outgassed 48 h at 523 K; L0 from E0 of N2 DR via Eq. (1).
measuring_lab_id: Fierro group, Institut Jean Lamour (IJL)

purification_method: washed with 1 M HCl, then distilled water until rinse pH constant near 6; dried in oven 24 h; sieved to 100-200 um
activation_method: anthracite ground (100-200 um) and physically mixed with alkali hydroxide XOH (X = Na or K), mass ratio XOH/anthracite 1 to 3, heated in N2 flow to Ta 973-1073 K for 1 h; route of this sample not stated
source_location: Table 2, row T3220, column "At 77 K and 4 MPa (%), ICMPE volumetric device" (p. 1908)
notes: Printed +/- 0.1. Pressure 4 MPa = 40 bar. Excess is named in the Table 2 title ("Hydrogen uptake (excess)") but not defined in the text, so basis_stated is false. wt% is "of the outgassed activated carbons" (Table 2 title), coded W1 stated. ICMPE Sieverts device; outgassed under primary vacuum at 493 K (219.85 C) for 12 h; H2 purity 6 N stored as 99.9999; PCI curves measured twice. Group leader not named in the paper: Latroche (last-listed ICMPE author) used. Table 1: rho_He 1.96 +/- 0.22 g/cm3 (skeletal density); S_BET from N2 at 77 K, BET P/P0 range and consistency criteria not stated; V_DR,N2 DR fit range Log(P0/P)^2 3.5-9.1, V_DR,CO2 (CO2 at 273 K) range 4.4-9.1; N2/CO2 outgassed 48 h at 523 K; L0 from E0 of N2 DR via Eq. (1).
free_volume_calibration: sample volume correction from He pycnometer density (AccuPyc 1330, temperature not stated); calibrated volumes
measuring_lab_id: Latroche group, Institut de Chimie et des Materiaux Paris-Est (ICMPE)
